module: Two-player LAN room discovery and reliable handoff

files.adapted: Explicit byte writer/reader, bounded names and room cache, beacon/join/roster validation, member lifecycle and timeout/retry design.
Nonblocking UDP broadcast socket boundary and transport-independent core separation.
Room/member view and lifecycle API design.
In-memory datagram routing and packet-loss test approach; Smash assertions and fixtures are new.
Unmodified upstream license retained at third_party/arcade-lan-lobby/LICENSE.

adaptation.clock: Caller-supplied monotonic milliseconds, independent of gameplay frame rate.
adaptation.wire: Separate versioned STVL control datagrams with explicit little-endian fields, exact length validation, per-room identity and per-join membership counter; delayed control packets from an earlier membership cannot act on a rejoin. Not compatible with donor gameplay protocol.
adaptation.start: START -> READY -> COMMIT -> ACK, token/endpoint-bound retries and exactly-once handoff to the existing Smash Handshake. The real game owner calls established after its authoritative handshake.
adaptation.ownership: LobbyUdp owns only separate control/discovery sockets. The frontend owns and reserves UdpTransport, binds peer endpoints and preserves existing rollback, inputs, CMOS, game state, sound and authoritative handshake.

distribution: Retain this provenance and reproduce the BSD notice with any authorized binary distribution. This adaptation does not authorize distributing ROMs or private generated sources.
